scope: Wedded Wonderland live travel offer (live pages only, read via Apify web-fetch on 2026-11-15; no site/ drafts used)
naming_note: The /travel page brands the service 'Wedded Wonderland Travel' with H1 'Destination wedding travel agent'. The perks are called 'Wonderland Benefits' on /wonderland-concierge and 'The perks on your stay' / 'VIP benefits' on /travel. The term 'Wedded Privileges' does NOT appear on any of the six live pages read today (brand-profile.md and link-map.md still use it). The concierge process step is named 'Travel & Honeymoon Concierge'.

facts.claim: The live travel page is branded Wedded Wonderland Travel and positions the service as a destination wedding travel agent.
facts.page_wording: Wedded Wonderland Travel. # Destination wedding travel agent

facts.claim: The travel service covers weddings, honeymoons and other celebration trips, from first idea to the return home.
facts.page_wording: For every celebration - weddings, honeymoons and the trips in between. The stays, the perks and the support behind every Wedded Wonderland journey, from first idea to homecoming.

facts.claim: The travel team plans the celebration-week hotel, pre and post nights, guest accommodation and honeymoon as one connected journey and stays reachable during the trip.
facts.page_wording: the celebration-week hotel, the pre and post nights, where your guests stay, the honeymoon ... We plan it as one connected journey rather than a stack of separate bookings, and we stay reachable while you are away.

facts.claim: Eligible bookings may include daily breakfast, a hotel credit, room upgrade priority, early check-in and late checkout, a welcome amenity, preferred rates and offers, VIP recognition, and extras such as transfers, onboard credit, spa or club access.
facts.page_wording: Daily breakfast ... Hotel credit ... Room upgrade priority ... Early check-in, late checkout ... Welcome amenity ... Preferred rates and offers ... VIP recognition ... Extras beyond the room: Depending on the booking: transfers, onboard credit, spa or club access, exclusive experiences.
facts.use_note: Always pair with the condition in F-005. Say 'may include', never 'includes'.

facts.claim: Perks vary by hotel, rate and dates, and the travel agent confirms in writing what applies before booking.
facts.page_wording: Inclusions vary by hotel, rate and dates - we confirm exactly what applies to your stay in writing before you book.
facts.use_note: Matches the cta-library travel_benefits wording 'Benefits vary by hotel and program'.

facts.claim: The page lists preferred-partner programs it books through: Four Seasons Preferred Partner, Rosewood Elite, Hyatt Prive, Marriott STARS and Luminous, Hilton For Luxury, Accor Preferred, IHG Destined, Belmond Bellini Club, The Peninsula PenClub, Mandarin Oriental Fan Club and Shangri-La Luxury Circle.
facts.page_wording: Our bookings are recognised across the industry's leading preferred-partner programs ... Participation and inclusions vary by property and dates.
facts.use_note: Brand self-claim. Do not name individual programs in the article until Nic confirms membership (see needs N-004). Safe phrasing: 'preferred-partner programs at luxury hotel groups'.

facts.claim: The travel page says its partnerships run across about a dozen programs such as Fora Travel, described as having 4,500 hotel properties worldwide.
facts.page_wording: We have partnerships across a dozen programs such as Fora Travel, with 4,500 hotel properties worldwide, which is a member of Four Seasons, Rosewood, Belmond Bellini Club, Hyatt Prive and many other exclusive luxury programs.
facts.use_note: Sentence is ambiguous (Fora Travel is a host agency, not a hotel program). Do not use in the article until Nic confirms the relationship (N-003).

facts.claim: Getting started on the travel service is a five-step process: tell us about the travel, agree the scope, receive a shortlist, book and brief the property, and ongoing support through and after the trip.
facts.page_wording: Tell us about the travel ... We agree the scope ... You receive a shortlist ... We book and brief the venue ... We stay with you

facts.claim: The first step takes about fifteen minutes and carries no obligation; asking costs nothing.
facts.page_wording: Step one takes about fifteen minutes, and there is no obligation to go further. ... No obligation, no cost to ask.

facts.claim: The shortlist gives two or three options with a recommendation, the rate, the cancellation terms and the confirmed inclusions.
facts.page_wording: Two or three options with a clear recommendation, the rate, the cancellation terms and the confirmed inclusions.

facts.claim: Scope can be hotel only, the full celebration week, guest travel, honeymoon or all of it, and any planning fee is disclosed before work starts.
facts.page_wording: Hotel only, the full celebration week, guest travel, honeymoon or all of it. If any planning fee applies, you know before we start.

facts.claim: A straightforward hotel booking usually carries no planning fee; complex itineraries, flights or group work may carry a fee agreed upfront.
facts.page_wording: A straightforward hotel booking usually carries no planning fee. More complex itineraries, flights or group work may carry a fee, agreed with you upfront before any work begins.
facts.use_note: No fee amount is stated. Do not quote a figure.

facts.claim: Preferred rates are often the same as the hotel's own flexible rate with perks added, and the team compares like for like and will say if booking direct is better.
facts.page_wording: Preferred rates are often the same as the hotel's own flexible rate, with the perks added on top. We will always compare like for like - same room, same taxes, same cancellation terms - and tell you if booking direct genuinely serves you better.

facts.claim: Upgrades and extended check-in or checkout are not guaranteed; they depend on hotel occupancy and are shown as requests rather than confirmed inclusions.
facts.page_wording: Upgrades and extended check-in or checkout generally depend on how full the hotel is that day. We will always show you which inclusions are confirmed and which are requests
facts.use_note: CONFLICT with F-024: /wonderland-concierge lists 'Guaranteed late checkout, on the night it matters most'. Article should follow the more cautious /travel wording until Nic resolves (N-006).

facts.claim: The hotel credit is typically one credit per room per stay, spent on eligible charges such as dining or spa, and unused value usually expires at checkout.
facts.page_wording: Typically one credit per room, per stay, spent on eligible charges such as dining or spa rather than taken off the room bill. Unused value usually expires at checkout

facts.claim: Perks usually cannot be added to a booking already made elsewhere; rebooking is considered only if it leaves the client better off.
facts.page_wording: Usually not to an existing booking made elsewhere. If the dates are still flexible and the rate is still available, we can look at rebooking - but only where it leaves you better off overall.

facts.claim: Group room blocks are contracted separately, and individual-booking perks do not carry across to them automatically.
facts.page_wording: Group contracts work differently to individual bookings, so the perks above do not carry across automatically. We negotiate and document group terms separately
facts.use_note: CONFLICT with F-025 and F-026: /wonderland-concierge promises 'The full Wonderland Benefits across your room block' and a 'property credit on every booked room'. Follow /travel until Nic resolves (N-007).

facts.claim: If something goes wrong during the trip, clients contact the travel team, who take it up with the property on their behalf.
facts.page_wording: You contact us. We have your booking, your written inclusions and the relationship with the property, and we take it up on your behalf

facts.claim: Inclusions are subject to partner program terms, and supplier booking conditions, deposit and cancellation terms apply.
facts.page_wording: subject to partner program terms which may change ... Supplier booking conditions, deposit and cancellation terms apply.

facts.claim: Travel enquiries start through the 'Start planning' form on /travel by sending dates and destination; the team replies with a shortlist, rates and inclusions.
facts.page_wording: Send us your dates and destination and we will come back with a shortlist, the rates and exactly what is included.

facts.claim: The concierge is the couple's single point of contact for venue sourcing, negotiating with resorts and airlines, room blocks and guest travel, local vendors, and deposits, payments and currency.
facts.page_wording: Your concierge is your single point of contact for all of it: sourcing and securing the venue, negotiating with resorts and airlines, managing room blocks and guest travel, coordinating trusted local vendors, and handling deposits, payments and currency so nothing gets lost across borders.

facts.claim: Wedded Wonderland describes itself as planner and travel concierge in one relationship.
facts.page_wording: A planner shapes the celebration; a travel concierge moves the people, the payments and the bookings across countries. Wedded Wonderland is both in one relationship

facts.claim: The concierge process has six steps ending in 'Travel & Honeymoon Concierge', and the Discovery Call covers travel and accommodation needs.
facts.page_wording: Step 01 Discovery Call ... Step 06 Travel & Honeymoon Concierge ... We discuss ... Existing bookings, Travel and accommodation needs

facts.claim: Wonderland Benefits at partner, preferred and consortia properties are listed as suite upgrades, a property credit on every booked room, daily breakfast for two, guaranteed late checkout, early check-in and welcome amenity, honeymoon perks, negotiated group rates with a private booking link, and priority access to Collection properties in peak dates.
facts.page_wording: Suite upgrades for the couple, the guest of honour and your VIPs ... A property credit on every booked room ... Guaranteed late checkout, on the night it matters most ... Negotiated group rates and a private booking link for your guests
facts.use_note: Wording has drifted from brand-profile.md and conflicts with /travel on guarantees and group blocks (F-014, F-017). Use only the softer /travel phrasing ('may include', 'upgrade priority').

facts.claim: Benefits apply only at partner, preferred and consortia properties, vary by hotel and program, and are confirmed before the couple commits.
facts.page_wording: Benefits apply at our partner, preferred and consortia properties and vary by hotel and by program. Properties outside these networks may not carry the same perks. Your concierge confirms exactly what your chosen venue includes before you commit.

facts.claim: The concierge page claims a destination wedding with 40 guest rooms can carry more in VIP benefits than the concierge fee.
facts.page_wording: A destination wedding or celebration with 40 guest rooms can carry more in VIP benefits at our preferred properties than the concierge fee itself costs you.
facts.use_note: Unquantified marketing claim and in tension with F-017 (group perks not automatic). Do not repeat without a worked example from Nic (N-008).

facts.claim: The Destination Wedding and Celebration Concierge package is listed from US$5,500 and includes guest travel and accommodation concierge, currency and international payments coordinated, honeymoon or celebration travel, and Wonderland Benefits across the room block.
facts.page_wording: Destination Wedding & Celebration Concierge. Starting from US$5,500 ... Guest travel and accommodation concierge ... Currency and international payments coordinated ... Honeymoon or celebration travel planned
facts.use_note: PRICE CONFLICT: brand-profile.md records 'starting from $3,500' with no currency; live page today says US$5,500. Price is in USD, not AUD. Brand rule: no Concierge prices in articles until Nic confirms. Inclusions list may be used without the price.

facts.claim: The Local Wedding and Celebration Concierge package is listed at US$3,000 and includes Wonderland Benefits at partner properties.
facts.page_wording: Local Wedding & Celebration Concierge US$3,000 ... Wonderland Benefits at our partner properties
facts.use_note: USD, not AUD. Do not publish until Nic confirms.

facts.claim: The 60-minute consultation is priced differently on two live pages: US$200 on /wonderland-concierge and US$207.00 (A$207.00 in Australia, including a 3.5% service fee) on /plan-your-destination-wedding.
facts.page_wording: Book the Advisory Session - US$207.00. A$207.00 for Australian customers - incl. 3.5% service fee
facts.use_note: Three-way conflict (brand-profile.md also records $250). Only the plan page gives an AUD figure ('A$207.00'). Do not publish any figure until Nic confirms.

facts.claim: A free, no-obligation Discovery Call with a Wedding Concierge Advisor is available, booked online.
facts.page_wording: A complimentary, no-obligation call with a Wedding Concierge Advisor to talk through your wedding and point you toward the right next step, at no cost.

facts.claim: Enquiries via the concierge form promise a reply within 24 hours, confidentiality and no obligation.
facts.page_wording: Reply in 24 hours. Fully confidential. No obligation

facts.claim: Why Choose Us lists one dedicated point of contact and wedding plus travel under one roof, managing wedding, guest travel and honeymoon.
facts.page_wording: One Dedicated Point of Contact: No juggling multiple suppliers, planners or travel agents. ... Wedding + Travel Under One Roof: We manage your wedding, guest travel and honeymoon experience.

facts.claim: Concierge page proof points: 800+ weddings and celebrations, 54 countries, 50k+ vetted vendors, $1.2B in weddings and celebrations, 15 years of editorial authority.
facts.page_wording: 800+ Weddings and celebrations. 54 Countries. 50k+ Vetted vendors. $1.2B In weddings and celebrations. 15yr Editorial authority
facts.use_note: 800+ and 54 countries also on /plan-your-destination-wedding. $1.2B has no currency; avoid. CONFLICT with F-034.

facts.claim: Package pages show different proof points: 10,000+ couples hosted (or weddings curated), 75+ countries and 1,200+ curated partners.
facts.page_wording: 10,000+ Couples Hosted. 75+ Countries. 1,200+ Curated Partners
facts.use_note: Conflicts with F-033 (800+, 54 countries). Use only 800+ weddings (in brand-profile) until Nic resolves (N-009).

facts.claim: The concierge team is led by Wendy El-Khoury and plans Lebanese, Egyptian, Indian, Western and multicultural celebrations.
facts.page_wording: Wedded Wonderland is led by Wendy El-Khoury and a team who plan Lebanese, Egyptian, Indian, Western and multicultural celebrations

facts.claim: Every destination wedding package includes a group room block held for guests and coordinated guest travel and transfers.
facts.page_wording: Included in every package: Your venue and wedding date, secured. A group room block held for your guests. Guest travel and transfers, coordinated.

facts.claim: Guest accommodation, flights, legal and documentation fees and extras are paid separately from wedding packages; guest rooms are usually at negotiated group rates.
facts.page_wording: Typically paid separately: flights, guest accommodation (usually at negotiated group rates), legal and documentation fees, and extras such as spa, excursions or additional events.

facts.claim: The wedding packages page says that once a wedding is booked, the destination wedding travel agent handles the hotel, the guests and the honeymoon.
facts.page_wording: Once it is booked, our destination wedding travel agent handles the hotel, your guests and the honeymoon.

facts.claim: Every honeymoon package includes the suite category, airport transfers, signature dining, spa, a private excursion and a dedicated specialist from enquiry to arrival.
facts.page_wording: Your suite category, secured at the right rate. Airport transfers and in-resort logistics. Signature dining and private reservations. A spa ritual or two, booked in advance. A private excursion that captures the place. A dedicated specialist from enquiry to arrival.

facts.claim: Wedding and honeymoon can be planned together, at one resort or two, with one specialist coordinating the whole trip.
facts.page_wording: We can stage the wedding at one resort and the honeymoon at another (or extend the same stay), with one specialist coordinating the whole trip

facts.claim: Recommended lead times are 12 to 18 months for a destination wedding and 6 to 9 months for a honeymoon.
facts.page_wording: For a destination wedding, 12-18 months is the comfortable lead time ... For a honeymoon, 6-9 months is ideal to lock in the right suite category

facts.claim: Package pages feature nine hand-picked resorts, each visited and vetted by the team: Akohara Buahan Village Retreat, Monarto Safari Lodge, Palm Island Suites Santorini, Regent Bali Canggu, SO/ Maldives, The Apurva Kempinski Bali, The Culture Samui, The Shore at Katathani, Tokoriki Island Resort.
facts.page_wording: NINE CURATED DESTINATION WEDDING PACKAGES ... Each property has been visited and vetted by the Wedded Wonderland team
facts.use_note: /wonderland-concierge shows AYANA Bali, Crown Sydney and Sofitel Fiji on the same images where the package pages show Akohara, Monarto and Tokoriki. Do not name these three until Nic confirms the current list (N-010).

facts.claim: The honeymoon page cites a market range for luxury honeymoon packages of around US$1,600 to US$30,000+ per person and says the team does not discount properties but negotiates value in upgrades and experiences.
facts.page_wording: honeymoon packages typically run from around US$1,600 to US$30,000+ per person, depending on destination, suite category, season and length of stay ... we never discount our properties; we negotiate value instead, in upgrades and experiences.
facts.use_note: Unsourced market range in USD, not our own price. Do not use the figure. The 'negotiate value, not discounts' line is usable with Nic's OK.

facts.claim: The wedding packages page cites 'independent industry estimates' of about US$10,000 for an average destination wedding versus US$35,000+ at home, without naming the source.
facts.page_wording: Independent industry estimates put the average destination wedding near US$10,000 at large all-inclusive resorts, against US$35,000 or more for a traditional wedding at home.
facts.use_note: Unattributed, US market, USD. Do not use.

facts.claim: Free planning tools on the destination planning page include multi-currency budget tracking and guest travel and RSVP status.
facts.page_wording: Multi-currency budget tracking. Guest travel & RSVP status. Timeline built around ceremony logistics. Website builder for guest travel info

facts.claim: Testimonials on /plan-your-destination-wedding are labelled on the live page as placeholders pending approval.
facts.page_wording: Placeholder quotes below - swap for approved, verified couple testimonials before launch.
facts.use_note: Do not quote any testimonial from this page. Flag to Nic that placeholder text is live.

facts.claim: The travel page asks clients for honesty about budget, a decision timeline, and any accessibility, allergy or dietary needs, and asks whether either partner holds hotel loyalty status.
facts.page_wording: Honesty about budget, a decision timeline, and any accessibility, allergy or dietary needs in your party. ... Do either of you hold hotel loyalty status or points worth using?

needs.need: How the travel service is paid: does Wedded Wonderland earn hotel or supplier commission on travel bookings, and is that disclosed? No live page states it. The concierge FAQ 'Do venues or vendors pay Wedded Wonderland?' is collapsed and its answer was not captured.
Who takes payment and deposits for travel bookings (paid to the hotel, to Wedded Wonderland, or via a host agency), and in what currency. Pages say 'deposit and cancellation terms apply' only.
Confirm the Fora Travel relationship (host agency or partner) and how to describe it publicly.

Confirm which named hotel programs (Four Seasons Preferred Partner, Rosewood Elite, Hyatt Prive, Marriott STARS and Luminous, Hilton For Luxury, Belmond Bellini Club, etc.) the business can be named as booking through.
Australian travel agent accreditation or membership (for example ATAS) and any licence or insurance status; not stated on live pages.
Resolve 'Guaranteed late checkout' (/wonderland-concierge) versus 'generally depend on how full the hotel is' (/travel).
Resolve whether room-block guests get perks: /wonderland-concierge says 'full Wonderland Benefits across your room block'; /travel says group perks 'do not carry across automatically'.
A real worked example (anonymised) of perk value on a room block, if the '40 guest rooms' claim is to be used.
Resolve proof points: 800+ weddings and 54 countries versus 10,000+ couples and 75+ countries; and currency of '$1.2B'.
Confirm the current nine-resort Collection (concierge page shows AYANA Bali, Crown Sydney, Sofitel Fiji; package pages show Akohara, Monarto, Tokoriki).

Confirm Concierge and consultation prices and the AUD figure to publish (US$5,500 / US$3,000 / US$200 / US$207 or A$207 incl 3.5% fee; brand-profile had $3,500 and $250). Brand rule: none in article until confirmed.
Size of the travel planning fee for complex itineraries, flights or group work ('may carry a fee'); no figure is published.
Whether the team books flights for couples and guests, and travel insurance; concierge FAQ 'Do you book flights and accommodation for wedding guests?' answer is collapsed and was not captured.
Approval to quote package-page testimonials (Olivia and James, Priya and Arjun, Noah and Sophie) and concierge real-wedding quotes; and a real travel-advisor client story for the article.
Naming: 'Wedded Privileges' is not on any live page read today. Confirm the public name for the perks (Wonderland Benefits?) and for the travel service (Wedded Wonderland Travel?).

tooling_note: WebFetch could not resolve weddedwonderland.com in this session; all pages were read with Apify web-fetch instead.
